parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A unique identifier that you provide to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: EnableUserPrometheus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable Prometheus on the client. Valid values:

- true: Enables Prometheus.

- false: Disables Prometheus.

parameters.name: OperationName
parameters.description: The name of the upgrade or downgrade action.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: The configuration parameters of the service instance.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the service instance.
